$comment: Canonical branch-protection RULESET for SkDD-conformant repos (thrillmade/protocol SPEC §7), vendored into clud-bug. Applied by `clud-bug configure-github <owner>/<repo>` (and the App's auto-setup); mirrors `reporulez apply <repo> skdd` and `logmind init --configure-github`. v2: migrated from the retired classic branch-protection payload to GitHub's rulesets API (POST/PUT repos/{owner}/{repo}/rulesets) — modern, layerable, org-portable. Tools MUST source this file; they MUST NOT redefine the ruleset in-tool. Filename kept as canonical-v1.json for link stability (stable fetch path); the `version` field is the authority.
name: skdd-canonical

$notes.format: GitHub rulesets API (POST repos/{owner}/{repo}/rulesets), NOT the retired classic branch-protection PUT. Rulesets layer and are org-portable; classic protection is legacy. The v1 classic schema is retired.
$notes.required_approving_review_count: 0 — the merge GATE is the required `clud-bug-review` STATUS CHECK (green only when the review ran and passed), NOT a human approval vote. This SUPERSEDES the v1 model (1 approval auto-satisfied by clud-bug[bot]'s APPROVE). 0 approvals keeps the solo + AI-maintainer flow friction-free; external-contributor safety comes from the repo's 'require approval for first-time contributors' setting plus a maintainer merging. Repo-owners MAY raise above 0; tools MUST NOT raise it by default and MUST NOT lower an owner-raised floor.
$notes.required_status_checks: the four canonical contexts every SkDD repo ships. Repos add project-specific contexts (e.g. `test`, `ci`, a pytest matrix) via `reporulez --extra-check`. A universal `test` context was REMOVED in v2 — not every repo ships one (e.g. protocol), and a missing context deadlocks merges.
$notes.bypass_actors: Repository admin (RepositoryRole id 5), bypass_mode always — the self-mod escape hatch. clud-bug's review action 401s on PRs that edit its own workflow files, and max-mode repos don't always post `clud-bug-review`, so an admin can merge without disabling the whole ruleset. Non-admins (including external contributors) get the full gate.
$notes.required_review_thread_resolution: true is the dogfood-defining rule: clud-bug findings posted as review threads MUST be resolved before merge.
$notes.interim_note: Until a repo reliably posts `clud-bug-review` (the hosted bot, or the local self-attested `post-check-run`), tools MAY apply the structural rules only (omit the required_status_checks rule, per the `external` variant) and add the checks once posting is confirmed. A repo MUST NOT permanently require a check that no producer posts.
